system.description:
[Trigger: Action] Used at the same time as your "Dash". That movement becomes [Instant Teleport]. Once per scenario. Boots imbued with magic that controls the wind, adorned with the wings of a large hawk. They allow for instantaneous jumps and high-speed movement through the air.

Huge Wind-Cutting Feather [Core Material] (140G) + Greaves (130G) ×3 + [Magic Catalyst 9] (90G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (430G)
